remarks: All utilities included! Thoughtfully updated and full of character, this inviting Westport home perfectly balances charm, comfort, and convenience. This beautifully updated 2-bedroom home with an additional loft-style bedroom is filled with natural light and architectural appeal. Soaring vaulted ceilings create an open, airy atmosphere, while the renovated kitchen and bathrooms blend style and comfort. Additional highlights include garage parking, a dedicated laundry room, and a location that puts downtown Westport, parks, shopping, dining, and transportation just moments away. Enjoy simplified living with utilities included and all the charm of one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities.
